items.name: eyebrow
items.title: Eyebrow
items.description: The one mono label recipe: 9.5px, 0.24em tracking, uppercase, optional NN prefix. Dark grounds render in the accent. Never restyle this recipe per section.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: section-header
items.title: Section Header
items.description: Eyebrow, heading and optional right-aligned side note. Three heading scales: section, feature, display. Heading weight is always 500 and the eyebrow gap is fixed.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The v2 CTA. Primary is a solid ground-inverted fill, ghost is a hairline. Sentence case, never a gradient, never a coloured fill. Renders an anchor when href is set. Self-contained: does not fork or overwrite the shadcn button.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: Differs from the jhai-new-website original: there, Button is an adapter over a forked src/components/ui/button.tsx. Shipping that fork would overwrite a consuming project's own button, so the four compound variants are inlined here instead. Rendered classes are identical.

items.name: check-list
items.title: Check List
items.description: The inclusion / pain list. Check is a accent tick for answers and inclusions; cross is a grey cross for pains. Never a red cross, never a coloured fill. Marks are lucide icons, not text glyphs.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: Stat Tile
items.description: One big tabular number with a mono caption and a left hairline. Skip the divider on the first tile of a row. Pair with @magicui/number-ticker for a count-up numeral.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: image-slot
items.title: Image Slot
items.description: The grey plate convention. Renders the image when src is set, otherwise a deliberate plate with its placeholder caption, so an empty slot reads as a hole in the layout rather than a broken image. Grayscale is the house treatment.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: The plate grey resolved through --ui-surface-strong for the registry build; it was a #ECECEA literal in the source repo. Same colour on JHAI, client colour elsewhere.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The JHAI lucide icon set and its name mapping. One place that decides which lucide glyph a named concept resolves to, so an icon does not drift between sections.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: rating-mark
items.title: Rating Mark
items.description: The one star recipe. Draws a 0-5 rating as characters so it inherits colour and size from its caption, and announces itself to a screen reader as a number rather than as five shapes. Halves round to the nearest half star.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: Never default `value`. A star mark is a factual claim about a real review; a component that defaults to 5 invents evidence every time a caller omits it. Omit the rating and draw nothing.
